summary: Fully tested new Receiver/Sink feature: /api/sink CRUD + status, full transmission loop (transmitter -> TCP ingest -> sink OPC UA + broadcast), dynamic tag adaptation (transmitter hot-reload every 2s -> new tag surfaces on sink within ~4s), Socket.IO 'sink_frame' + 'sink_stats' events with correct schema, and Frontend Receiver mode UI (start/stop, listening indicator, endpoint text, live tiles, sparklines, terminal, KPIs, dynamic NEW-badge surfacing, stop, mode toggles). All 4 new pytest cases pass. All UI checks pass.

issues: Recharts logs many 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings for sparklines (non-fatal). Consider setting explicit minWidth/minHeight or using aspect to silence the console noise.

action_items: Optional: silence Recharts sparkline width/height warnings in ReceivedTile by giving the container a minHeight/minWidth or aspect ratio.

Optional: regression test file /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py has 3 pre-existing failures (test_demo_server_present_and_connected asserts tag_count==5 but demo server currently has 7 tags after prior manual testing; test_tag_crud_and_duplicate hard-codes Vibration which is now already added; test_ws_rapid_reconnect intermittent). These are test brittleness, not product bugs, and were noted in the review request context. Consider making these tests idempotent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 788 lines and starting to accumulate multiple responsibilities (OPC UA client, runtime transmit loop, TCP ingest server, sink server bridge, sio, REST). Would benefit from splitting into modules (routes/, runtime.py, ingest.py) before further growth.

_forward_to_ingest opens a fresh TCP connection per frame (asyncio.open_connection with 1s timeout). For higher throughput consider a persistent socket pool; currently OK because both endpoints are localhost.

SinkOPCUAServer.upsert writes _norm(value) which coerces all numerics to float. This is fine for display but loses Int64 semantics on the re-published server; if downstream OPC UA clients depend on data types this is a mismatch (source Int64 becomes Double on sink).

SinkOPCUAServer.reset uses delete_nodes but leaves self.server running; that's correct. However there is no guard if server is None when reset is called before start (currently start() is always called before reset() in /api/sink/start, so OK).
seed_data_creation: Test transiently adds a Plant variable tag (via UI and via API) and deletes it after verification. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sink feature verified end-to-end. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_sink.py. Note: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py has 3 pre-existing assertion failures due to demo tag list growing during earlier manual tests (tag_count 7 vs 5, and 'Vibration' already added). These are test-side brittleness, not product regressions. Runtime transmit-loop hot-reload (every 2s) works as designed: adding a source tag causes the sink to auto-create the corresponding node/tile within ~2-4s without any receiver reconfig. Sink OPC UA endpoint is opc.tcp://127.0.0.1:4841/emergent/sink/. Socket.IO path: /api/socket.io; events: sink_frame (per received frame) and sink_stats (periodic + on connect + on start/stop).
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in the receiver/sink feature.
